title: Exclusion Report
description: The result of excluding packages from an SBOM.

name.description: The name of the source package.

version.description: The version of the source package.

matched_patterns.description: Binary exclusion patterns that matched at least one package.

unmatched_patterns.description: Binary exclusion patterns that did not match any package.

matched_sources.description: Source exclusions that matched a source package.

unmatched_sources.description: Source exclusions that did not match any source package.

removed_binaries.description: References of the removed binary packages.

removed_sources.description: References of the removed source packages.
